citations.assessment: The Mishnah names two judges. The Bavli baraita gives Admon’s patronym and lists three judges in a different formulation. The discussion distinguishes the lists and explains decrees about robbery.
The opening names the judges and counts Chanan’s two and Admon’s seven rulings. The complete cited sequence 13:3–9 contains Admon’s seven. Gamliel endorses Admon at 13:3–5.
The inheritance and maintenance dispute gives Admon’s position and Gamliel’s endorsement. It parallels Ketubot 13:3.
The matching oil-jar dispute and endorsement appear at 6:3 in the retrieved edition. Original 6:13 label retained. Exact printed numbering or typographical cause remains open.
The oil-jar case in the daf’s Mishnah contains the stated approval. The nearby wheat/barley case is a separate ruling.
The related entry names Dosa and Yochanan ben Zakkai in Chanan’s two cases. Ketubot 13:1–2 distinguishes this debate from Gamliel’s endorsements of Admon.
Maimonides lists Avtalyon, Chanan, Admon and Meyasha in the sixth group. This supports the attributed grouping as a textual report.
